product.title: West Maui and Molokai Special 45-Minute Helicopter Tour

description.text: On this exclusive helicopter tour of Maui, soar past valleys and hidden waterfalls that are inaccessible by land, and hover above ridgelines that sit at the heart of the rugged West Maui mountains. Cross the channel to neighboring Molokai, where vertical sea cliffs spill 4,000 feet to the turbid shoreline below, and get up-close views of a part of the world that has barely been touch by man. Stops include West Maui Mountains, Molokai. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Maui's volcanoes, waterfalls, reefs, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
